name: Apollo 12 ALSEP
about: Apollo 12 ALSEP (1969-099, MSC), launched 1969 Nov 14. Its phases from GCAT: Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is

events.why: GCAT marks this date uncertain or gives it without an hour
